name: Dark Snoot Fan game
source:
Dark Snoot is a mix of Dark Souls and Snoot Game, where we play from the perspective of Anon and Fang helps us in battles. The game has an original plot that begins after the end of the third part of DS. 

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SnootGame/comments/1khkoo3/dark_snoot_is_out/]Reddit[/url]]
